cases.name: Tyesha Kemp
cases.about: She was a nurse. "She would tell me that I'm OK, that I can get through this," said Ereka Bunn, Kemp's sister. The two have been tied at the hip since the Bunn family adopted Kemp at 6-weeks-old. Bunn said they were best friends."She was so loving and caring. She always wanted to make sure everyone was OK," Bunn said. Kemp was a loving mother to 2-year-old Gavin Gerald. She started her journey to becoming a nurse back in high school, earning a full ride scholarship for all of her schooling. She finally reached her goal and was a nurse.
